name: form-builder
title: Form Builder
description: Dynamic form builder for Jyavani CMS: Elementor-style drag-and-drop builder (rows → columns → fields), input fields & content elements (heading levels, rich text with Quill + CMS gallery/file modals, image, raw HTML with CodeMirror), priced options with live totals, soft-delete Bin with restore, embed via [form slug="..."] shortcode, per-form submissions with auto filters, bulk actions, CSV export, custom CSS/JS, and per-form access control.
author: Adam Muiz
